definitions.explanation: Satisfaction with oneself or one's achievements, often implying an uncritical or excessive level.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{単|たん}なる→単なる：01757_tannaru⟧{自己満足|じこまんぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
{自己満足|じこまんぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}っている→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This is not the time to be complacent.

examples.japanese: {自己満足|じこまんぞく}⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It may be self-gratifying, but I'm glad I did it.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ (self) + ⟦{満足|まんぞく}→満足：02496_manzoku⟧ (satisfaction) → self-satisfaction
Often shortened to 「⟦{自己満|じこまん}→自己満：14334_jikoman⟧」 in casual speech.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {自己満足|じこまんぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{過|す}ぎない→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ - is nothing but self-satisfaction
- {自己満足|じこまんぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}る→浸る：13339_hitaru⟧ - to bask in self-satisfaction
- {自己満足|じこまんぞく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{陥|おちい}る→陥る：14537_ochiiru⟧ - to fall into self-complacency

USAGE:
Often used negatively, implying that someone is satisfied with themselves without considering others' perspectives or actual results. However, it can also be used neutrally or even positively in some contexts.

- ⟦{自己紹介|じこしょうかい}→自己紹介：12331_jikoshoukai⟧ - self-introduction
